# Paper invitation fonts

Gowun Batang Regular and Gowun Dodum Regular are provided under the SIL Open Font License. The complete license notices are included in this directory.

Source: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gowun+Batang:wght@400&family=Gowun+Dodum&display=swap

These are unmodified official Google Fonts WOFF2 subsets. The subsets needed for the invitation were selected locally; invitation text and personal information were not sent to a font service. `dist/paper-fonts.css` retains their original Unicode ranges so browsers only load the needed subsets.

The browser loads fonts locally. When adding text, check that its characters are covered; otherwise the system fallback is used.
